<quote by="Proposed: Sermersuaq, Seconded: Hercynia">To build Floerstrand, a "Hot Spring Hall", in Tanikipari as detailed in last season's appraisal of Sermersuaq's prosperity</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Tanikipari, Sermersuaq as per the '''[[Farm,_fur,_and_fish#Hostel_and_Hot_Water|Farm, fur, and fish]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed at 15 thrones
* 15 thrones disbursed to Senator for Sermersuaq. 
==Date==
* Autumn 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 20 white granite
* 60 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Floerstrand}}
==Outcome==
Now the Floerstrand is complete, the position of [[Thane of Floerstrand]] will be available to appoint by unanimous vote of the senators of [[Wintermark]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE
